item.title: Cruz Beckham’s Famous Parents Give Him Solid Career Advice
item.description:
[Intro music fades out]
Host: Welcome back to "Trending Now"! Today, we're talking about Cruz Beckham, the 21-year-old son of Victoria and David Beckham, who's making a name for himself in the music industry. Cruz is set to release his debut EP, "Wear & Tear", on August 21st via Republic Records.
[Short music transition]
Host: Cruz recently sat down with Mack and Jen from SiriusXM Hits 1 Miami to talk about his new music and the advice he's received from his famous parents. He shared that his mom and dad have taught him to work on his craft and be the best version of himself. And when it comes to pep talks, it's his mom who gives the best motivation.
[Clip of Cruz Beckham's interview plays]
Cruz Beckham: "She's just like, 'Well, you're going to do it anyway, so make sure you do it the best of your ability...'"
Host: Cruz also mentioned that he listens to the opinion of his girlfriend, a songwriter, and that he's excited to release his EP, which features songs he's been working on for the past two to three years.
[Short music transition]
Host: To support his new music, Cruz will be embarking on his debut US headline tour, starting on July 28th in Washington, DC. He'll also be making appearances at festivals like Lollapalooza, Outside Lands, and Reading and Leeds. You can check out the full list of tour dates on our website.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for today, folks! Make sure to mark your calendars for Cruz Beckham's EP release on August 21st and catch him on tour this summer. We'll be keeping an eye on this rising star, and we can't wait to see what he does next.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
